texts.eyebrow: Plzeň · tramvaje · PMDP · pátek 18. 9. 2026 · odpolední špička
texts.lede: The trams on each kurz in the Friday afternoon peak, set on the tram network as it stood on Sun 27 Sep 2026, for the Simutrans model: line list, schedule, fleet and pak objects. The vehicles are from Fri 18 Sep 2026, because Plzeň has no records at all for 23–25 Sep; 18 Sep is the latest complete Friday. The timetable is the PMDP one in force on 27 Sep.
texts.network_intro: The weekday timetable in force on 27 Sep (PMDP GTFS, valid from 22 Sep; service day Fri 25 Sep). Departures are the trips starting from each terminus between 16:00 and 16:59. Headway is the median gap between 15:00 and 18:00, runtime the average scheduled time from first to last stop. Depot runs are left out. All termini are loops: the whole fleet except the Tatra KT8D5 is single-ended.
texts.pak_intro: The pak owner is adding the whole PMDP fleet to VZ-PMDP-tram.pak in the PMDP yellow-grey-white livery (pmdpzlutosedobila). Every type in the peak now has its own object (pak128 main 6547eb6): T3R.PLF, VarioLFR.S / VarioLF plus (one object), KT8D5R.N2P, EVO2, 40T (one object for 40T0/1/2) and VarioLF2/2 IN. There are no stand-ins left. The lists above show only the pak core, the last part of the object name.
method: Vehicles. seznam-autobusu.cz vypravenost for MHD Plzeň, Fri 18 Sep 2026, lines 1, 2 and 4 (line 1). The site has no Plzeň tram records for 23, 24 or 25 Sep; Mon 21 and Tue 22 Sep are complete too and show the same kurz structure. Ráno marks a morning-only car, odpoledne the afternoon car, ráno i odpoledne a split duty, výměna za X a car replaced by X, and náhrada za Y the replacement.

Cross-check. Chaining the Fri 25 Sep timetable gives 14, 14 and 22 trams in service at 16:00 on lines 1, 2 and 4, against 14, 15 and 22 kurzy recorded on 18 Sep. One line 2 split duty is probably already back in the depot at 16:00.

Types, depot, livery. The seznam-autobusu register for PMDP trams, read on 28 Sep 2026. Lengths for the model are approximate: 15 m per car for T3R.PLF, VarioLFR.S and VarioLF+, about 20 m for EVO2, 40T and VarioLF2/2IN, and 30 m for KT8D5.RN2P.
Timetable. PMDP GTFS (jizdnirady.pmdp.cz/jr/gtfs), valid from 22 Sep 2026; trips running on Fri 25 Sep.

Simutrans schedule. Fitted to the afternoon peak in whole calendar minutes with the fork’s Departure every / Offset / Also at fields: the longest stretch that one pattern reproduces exactly, around 15:00–16:00 for lines 1 and 2 and from 16:00 for line 4. Loop terminus: set 1 min before the timetable departure so the tram clears the loop on time. Every Plzeň terminus is a loop, so every entry is the real minute − 1.
Pak objects. From the pak128 session: VZ-PMDP-tram.pak, pak128 main 6547eb6, all in PMDP yellow-grey-white (pmdpzlutosedobila). Every type in the peak has an exact object.
